name: Rumtek Monastery
description: A majestic Buddhist monastery known for its stunning architecture and spiritual ambiance, serving as the seat of the Karmapa Lama.

name: Tsomgo Lake
description: A glacial lake at 12,400 ft surrounded by snow-capped mountains, offering breathtaking views and yak rides in winter.

name: MG Marg
description: The vibrant pedestrian-only street in the heart of Gangtok, lined with shops, cafes, and cultural performances.

name: Enchey Monastery
description: A serene 200-year-old monastery perched on a hill, known for its peaceful environment and annual religious dances.

name: Namgyal Institute of Tibetology
description: A premier research center with a vast collection of Tibetan artifacts, manuscripts, and statues, offering deep insights into Tibetan culture.

name: Banjhakri Falls and Energy Park
description: A beautiful waterfall surrounded by lush greenery and a park dedicated to traditional healing and shamanic energy.

name: Do Drul Chorten
description: One of the largest stupas in Sikkim, surrounded by 108 prayer wheels, symbolizing peace and enlightenment.

name: Ganesh Tok
description: A small temple dedicated to Lord Ganesh offering panoramic views of Gangtok and the surrounding Himalayan ranges.

name: Tashi View Point
description: A famous viewpoint to witness spectacular sunrise and views of Mount Kanchenjunga and the eastern Himalayas.

name: Flower Exhibition Centre
description: A vibrant center showcasing exotic flowers and plants native to Sikkim, ideal for botany enthusiasts and photographers.

name: Ranka Monastery
description: A peaceful monastery known for its intricate murals and tranquil surroundings away from the city bustle.

name: Ganesh Tok Viewpoint
description: A hidden gem viewpoint offering serene views of the city and the snow-capped mountains beyond.

name: Nam Nang View Point
description: A lesser-known viewpoint offering stunning vistas of the Kanchenjunga range and the lush valleys below.

name: Do-Drul Chorten Stupa
description: A sacred stupa surrounded by prayer wheels, representing one of the most important religious sites in Gangtok.

name: Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park
description: A high-altitude zoo housing rare Himalayan species like red pandas and snow leopards in naturalistic habitats.

name: Do-Drul Chorten Prayer Wheels
description: A circle of 108 prayer wheels surrounding the Do-Drul Chorten stupa, offering a unique spiritual experience.

name: Lingdum Monastery
description: A peaceful monastery known for its beautiful murals and tranquil environment, perfect for meditation and reflection.

name: Ganesh Tok Park
description: A quiet park near Ganesh Tok temple offering shaded seating and panoramic views of the city and mountains.

name: Namgyal Institute of Tibetology Library
description: A specialized library within the institute housing rare Tibetan manuscripts and texts for scholarly research.
